reason: The continuity rule and the audit's continuity check exempt plain 3Rs ('no passive coordinate; flood not required'), but a plain 3R working against its stretched fold can take static islands. The verifier's kNN-8 flood of the s10 config (the dashboard's sweep number) found 6 taken poses at elev 90 (planes -15..60, axial 15-45) that no continuous path from rest reaches at the 5 deg margin: 1.67 reach points that exist only statically. The claimed config is clean: tools/alignment_kit_flood.py (new; runs the verifier's own extras() on the per-pose dumps) finds 207 / 207 taken ws poses connected on the bench and 207 / 207 held, and reproduces the th margins 6.462 / 5.313. So the claim stands, and the exemption is the gap: a plain-3R number near the fold is never flood-checked unless a verifier volunteers it.
